# Server API Reference

The **`recipes`** namespace, available to scripts in the **`minelark/server/`** folder. Recipes are reloadable data - re-apply them in-game with `/minelark reload`. Ids and tags without a namespace default to `minecraft:`; prefix a tag with `#`.

Server scripts also react to [events](events.md), send styled [text](text.md), and register their own [commands](commands.md).

---

## `recipes.blasting(result, ingredient, experience = 0.0, cooking_time = 100)`

Adds a blast furnace recipe (usually half the smelting time).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | any | yes | - | The output item id. |
| `ingredient` | any | yes | - | The input item or `#tag` id. |
| `experience` | any | no | `0.0` | Experience granted. |
| `cooking_time` | int | no | `100` | Cooking time in ticks. |

---

## `recipes.shaped(result, pattern, key, count = 1)`

Adds a shaped crafting recipe. `pattern` is 1-3 rows of up to 3 characters; `key` maps each character to an item or `#tag`. A space means an empty slot.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | any | yes | - | The output item id (namespaced as minecraft: by default). |
| `pattern` | any | yes | - | A list of 1-3 equal-length rows, e.g. `["RRR", "R R", "RRR"]`. |
| `key` | any | yes | - | A dict of single-character -> item/`#tag` id. |
| `count` | int | no | `1` | How many result items to craft. |

---

## `recipes.shapeless(result, ingredients, count = 1)`

Adds a shapeless crafting recipe from 1-9 ingredients (items or `#tag`s).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | any | yes | - | The output item id. |
| `ingredients` | any | yes | - | A list of 1-9 item/`#tag` ids. |
| `count` | int | no | `1` | How many result items to craft. |

---

## `recipes.smelting(result, ingredient, experience = 0.0, cooking_time = 200)`

Adds a furnace smelting recipe.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | any | yes | - | The output item id. |

## `recipes.smoking(result, ingredient, experience = 0.0, cooking_time = 100)`

Adds a smoker recipe (for food).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | any | yes | - | The output item id. |

| `cooking_time` | int | no | `100` | Cooking time in ticks. |
